  outside closes it; the phone's long-press menu is off on sheet links
- workspace.css: callout and text selection off on sheet links on coarse
  pointers (outside the @scope so table links are covered)
- 390 x 844 audit of all 16 pages: no sideways overflow, no nested
  vertical scrollers, sticky tab row
- Plan 05 marked built; playbook milestone

photos and attachment fix, markdown editor changes
Apply Kolkrabbi design system with strict 4px border-radius and RightGrotesk Mono 12px typography

docs: update session log and memory with recent features

Document shape preset implementation, number inputs for exceeding slider ranges, and other radial editor enhancements.

feat: add comprehensive animation system and enhanced radial controls

Add parameter animation with visual feedback dots, number inputs for all sliders, shape presets (circle, rectangle, triangle, star, hexagon, random, chaos), LFO wave types with visual icons, smooth/sharp corners toggle, mirror symmetry, alt+scroll zoom, and reposition color pickers to appear above swatches.

refactor: reorganize icon system and improve input components

- Create active/library icon structure (23 active, 464 library icons)
- Add Stepper atom component with custom chevron controls
- Fix Input component padding and width constraints
- Update Icon loader to support new folder structure
- Replace raw input elements with Input/Stepper components
- Update 15+ components to use new icon paths
- Add comprehensive documentation for icon system
- Remove 26 alphabetical icon folders and cleanup
- Add git-commit slash command

Improves bundle organization, component consistency, and maintainability.

feat: consolidate design system, fix color inconsistencies, and remove shadows

- Import 57 components from ui-shared-library-monorepo (34 atoms, 23 molecules)
- Create barrel exports in atoms/index.js, molecules/index.js, and components/index.js
- Consolidate duplicate icon folders into single src/components/icons/ location
- Fix 15 color inconsistencies across components:
  - Replace hardcoded hex colors (#27272a) with design system tokens
  - Convert Tailwind utilities (blue-500, orange-500) to design system colors
  - Fix undefined token classes (bg-opacity-hex-fixed-88 → bg-fg-88)
  - Create DEFAULT_BLACK/WHITE constants using CSS custom properties
- Remove all shadow styling (7+ instances) for flat design aesthetic
- Update 80+ SVG icons to use currentColor for dynamic theming
- Configure dark mode as default theme (index.html, ThemeToggle.jsx)
- Fix React warning by destructuring square prop in Button component
- Add Divider component between filter items in Inspector
- Remove irrelevant chess piece ic

Add home screen, file routing, improved drag-drop, and expanded filters

- Add HomeScreen page with file management and routing by fileId
- Refactor LayersSidebar drag-drop: horizontal position detection for
  drop-inside vs reorder (40/60 split), constrained horizontal movement
- Redesign Toolbar filter menu with collapsible groups (8 categories, 40+ filters)
- Update TopNav with editable file name and home navigation
- Improve RangeSlider styling with custom thumb and step support
- Add data-layer-id attributes for DOM queries
- Reorganize docs into documentation/ and llm-context-protocol/session-logs/
- Add photo tool to toolbar
